stories.title: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on Canada; trade talks collapse
new_facts: Carney called the tariffs a 'miscalculation' and said Canada walked away to protect its sovereignty
New figure: tariffs hit about 5% of Canada's annual exports to the US, covering goods like hockey sticks and tongue depressors
Carney's full quote: US last-minute changes were 'unfair, uneconomic' and undermined deal reliability
First report: US imposes 50% tariff on $20bn Canadian imports; Canada vows dollar-for-dollar retaliation.
stories.line: Trump imposes 50% tariffs on Canadian goods; Canada announces retaliatory tariffs after trade negotiations fail.

stories.title: Chinese robot runs 100 meters faster than Usain Bolt's record
new_facts: Robots also broke a high jump record at the Beijing World Humanoid Robot Games, not just 100m sprint.
Names event World Humanoid Robot Games, 2nd edition, 2,000+ robots, 5-day event at Beijing's National Speed Skating Oval until Aug 26.
Lightning had already set a prior world record in the half marathon before its 100m feat.
New story: Chinese robot 'Lightning' beat Usain Bolt's 100m record (9.32s) at Beijing's 'android Olympics'; previously set half-marathon record too.
Adds specific peak speed of 14.5 m/s for the robot's record-breaking 100m run, per Chinese state media.
Identifies robot's developer as smartphone maker Honor; names event as the second World Humanoid Robot Games, starting Saturday.
stories.line: A Chinese humanoid robot completed a 100-meter sprint faster than Usain Bolt's human world record at a robot competition.

stories.line: LSU student filmed dragging a Black doll by rope on campus; university has not publicly responded to the incident.

stories.title: Supreme Court allows Trump White House renovations to proceed
new_facts: New story: Trump suspends tariffs on 300,000 metric tons of imported ground beef, sparking GOP and rancher backlash.
Reveals Melania Trump arranged first-term placement of an Isamu Noguchi sculpture near the Rose Garden.
Names Chief Justice John Roberts as the specific issuer of the ballroom construction stay.
White House Rose Garden redone with stone patio and statues of American founders.
New story: Trump accused of living in a 'billionaire bubble,' touting crypto/data centers amid inflation concerns.
stories.line: Trump is renovating White House grounds and ballrooms; Supreme Court rejected a temporary halt.
